description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:476 — DeviationStore::expired_at uses .map_or(false, |end| now_unix >= end) instead of .is_some_and(|end| now_unix >= end). Clippy -D warnings flags this as an error (unnecessary_map_or). Fix: replace with is_some_and.
title: clippy: map_or(false, ...) should be is_some_and() in deviation.rs
